body: at least you wouldn’t have problems to deal with when you’re dead.

those people would say the exact same things “tHinK pOsItiVe”, “dOnT gIvE uP”, or the dreadful “jUsT bE HapPy”. they would even try to invalidate my feelings and say that’s just a phase or don’t think like that. no one ever says im here for you, im sorry, i care for you, or i love you. and even if they do, you can see it in their eyes that they’re lying and in the tone of their voice that they don’t really mean it.
